appliesTo: All newly authored template sample photography. Preserve existing and saved artwork unless separately requested.

sources.ownership: Every template owns its sample photo set, including all interiors and all aspect variants.
sources.reuse: Never reuse another template's photograph, including renamed, resized or reencoded copies.
sources.provenance: Save the full prompt, generated original path, final workspace asset path and SHA-256 for every photograph.

people.direction: Ordinary people in plausible everyday situations, with natural unposed expressions and typical varied body types.
people.appearance: Natural skin texture and age-appropriate details, practical hair, ordinary clothing and glasses where appropriate.
people.principle: Visual quality comes from framing, storytelling, light and layout, rather than idealizing people's appearance.

layoutReview.groupPhotos: Retain all group members. Recompose the layout when a full-height crop would remove someone.
layoutReview.type: Inspect real bundled-font rendering, including mixed Korean/English labels, for missing glyphs, clipping and overlap.
layoutReview.materials: Use subtle photo-compatible stationery; keep strong printed rules away from captions.
layoutReview.performance: Keep current lazy preparation, decode-size limits and bounded caches. Do not preload a whole collection.
